title: A one-choice run is one step
statement: Let $B$ be a language of Boolean strings, let $b$ be a Boolean choice, let $x$ be a Boolean input string, and let $c$ be any machine configuration on input $x$. Running the machine from $c$ with the one-bit choice string $[b]$ gives the same configuration as taking one step from $c$ using choice $b$.
hypotheses_covered: B is a language of Boolean strings
x is a Boolean input string
c is a configuration on input x
